statement: Small cutoff gives vanishing likelihood, and failure of attainment means that the matched normal is the exact, strictly unbeaten supremum.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (m : ℝ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : let L := fun c ↦ logLikelihood x c m s let B := Normal.logLik x m s Tendsto L (𝓝[>] 0) atBot ∧ Tendsto L atTop (𝓝 B) ∧ ((¬ ∃ c ∈ Ioi (0 : ℝ), IsMaxOn L (Ioi 0) c) ↔ (∀ c ∈ Ioi (0 : ℝ), L c < B) ∧ IsLUB (L '' Ioi 0) B)

statement: For any log likelihood level strictly above the held-scale Gaussian value at the mean, one compact rectangle contains the joint superlevel. The bounds apply to both coordinates independently of any choice of conditional location maximizer.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {s J : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hJ : Normal.logLik x (Normal.mean x) s < J) : ∃ K : Set (ℝ × ℝ), IsCompact K ∧ K ⊆ Ioi 0 ×ˢ univ ∧ ∀ p ∈ Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ), J ≤ logLikelihood x p.1 p.2 s → p ∈ K

statement: A finite conditional location optimum with zero profile derivative and height at least the held-scale normal value exists exactly when the joint likelihood attains a maximum.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : let D := Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ) let L := fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ logLikelihood x p.1 p.2 s (∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D p) ↔ ∃ c > 0, ∃ m : ℝ, IsMaxOn (fun u ↦ logLikelihood x c u s) univ m ∧ HasDerivAt (fun t ↦ sSup ((fun u ↦ logLikelihood x t u s) '' univ)) 0 c ∧ Normal.logLik x (Normal.mean x) s ≤ logLikelihood x c m s

statement: At held scale only the normal can be an unattained supremum. For constant data every finite point strictly loses to that face.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : let D := Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ (univ : Set ℝ) let L := fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ logLikelihood x p.1 p.2 s let N := Normal.logLik x (Normal.mean x) s ((¬ ∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D p) ↔ (∀ p ∈ D, L p < N) ∧ IsLUB (L '' D) N) ∧ (∀ m : ℝ, (∀ j, x j = m) → ∀ p ∈ D, L p < N)

statement: Uniform small-cutoff comparison in the Laplace scale chart. It holds for arbitrary location, arbitrary positive scale, and all ties.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (m : ℝ) {c b : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hb : 0 < b) : logLikelihood x c m (c*b) ≤ Laplace.logLik x m b + (n : ℝ)*c^2

statement: Coercive upper bound in an effective scale that equals the Gaussian scale at large cutoff and the Laplace scale at small cutoff.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (m : ℝ) {c s : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (hs : 0 < s) : let t := s / min c 1 let A := min (log (sqrt (2*π))) (log 2 - 1/2) logLikelihood x c m s ≤ -(n : ℝ)*log t + (n : ℝ)*(1/2-A) - (∑ j, |x j - m|)/t

statement: A common compact box contains the joint superlevel for all feasible locations, once the level is strictly above both compatible faces. The location set can be the whole line or a held singleton.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {S : Set ℝ} (hS : IsClosed S) {D N E J : ℝ} (hD : 0 < D) (hdev : ∀ m ∈ S, D ≤ ∑ j, |x j - m|) (hnorm : ∀ m ∈ S, ∀ s > 0, Normal.logLik x m s ≤ N) (hlap : ∀ m ∈ S, ∀ b > 0, Laplace.logLik x m b ≤ E) (hN : N < J) (hE : E < J) : ∃ K : Set (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)), IsCompact K ∧ K ⊆ Ioi 0 ×ˢ (S ×ˢ Ioi 0) ∧ ∀ p ∈ Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ (S ×ˢ Ioi 0), J ≤ logLikelihood x p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2 → p ∈ K

statement: The all-free Huber criterion and failure classification. On nonconstant samples it compares a conditional optimum with zero profile derivative to the two fitted faces. Constant samples collapse unboundedly.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) : let A := Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ LocationScale.domain let L := fun p : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) ↦ logLikelihood x p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2 let N := Normal.logLik x (Normal.mean x) (Normal.sd x (Normal.mean x)) let mE := Laplace.lowerMedian x hn let E := Laplace.logLik x mE (Laplace.meanAbsDev x mE) let B := max N E ((∃ p ∈ A, IsMaxOn L A p) ↔ (∃ i j, x i ≠ x j) ∧ ∃ c > 0, ∃ m s : ℝ, 0 < s ∧ IsMaxOn (fun q : ℝ × ℝ ↦ logLikelihood x c q.1 q.2) LocationScale.domain (m,s) ∧ HasDerivAt (fun t ↦ sSup ((fun q : ℝ × ℝ ↦ logLikelihood x t q.1 q.2) '' LocationScale.domain)) 0 c ∧ B ≤ logLikelihood x c m s) ∧ ((¬ ∃ p ∈ A, IsMaxOn L A p) ↔ ((¬ ∃ i j, x i ≠ x j) ∧ ¬ BddAbove (L '' A)) ∨ ((∃ i j, x i ≠ x j) ∧ (∀ p ∈ A, L p < B) ∧ IsLUB (L '' A) B))

statement: The held-location Huber criterion and failure classification. At nonzero residuals the finite conditional scale and zero profile derivative are compared to the matched-location faces. Zero residuals collapse.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (m : ℝ) : let A := Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ Ioi (0 : ℝ) let L := fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ logLikelihood x p.1 m p.2 let N := Normal.logLik x m (Normal.sd x m) let E := Laplace.logLik x m (Laplace.meanAbsDev x m) let B := max N E ((∃ p ∈ A, IsMaxOn L A p) ↔ (∃ i, x i ≠ m) ∧ ∃ c > 0, ∃ s > 0, IsMaxOn (logLikelihood x c m) (Ioi 0) s ∧ HasDerivAt (fun t ↦ sSup (logLikelihood x t m '' Ioi 0)) 0 c ∧ B ≤ logLikelihood x c m s) ∧ ((¬ ∃ p ∈ A, IsMaxOn L A p) ↔ ((∀ j, x j = m) ∧ ¬ BddAbove (L '' A)) ∨ ((∃ j, x j ≠ m) ∧ (∀ p ∈ A, L p < B) ∧ IsLUB (L '' A) B))

statement: The held-centre problem either collapses on the normal seam, has a strictly unattained penalized uniform envelope, or has a finite maximum.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {a m : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) : (¬ ∃ s ∈ Ioi (0 : ℝ), IsMaxOn (likelihood x a m) (Ioi 0) s) ↔ (a = 0 ∧ (∀ i, x i = m) ∧ Tendsto (likelihood x a m) (𝓝[>] 0) atTop) ∨ (0 < a ∧ (∀ i, |x i - m| ≤ a) ∧ let u := ∏ i, (if |x i - m| = a then (1 : ℝ)/2 else 1)/(2*a) IsLUB (likelihood x a m '' Ioi 0) u ∧ ∀ s > 0, likelihood x a m s < u)

statement: Width zero uses precisely the normal argmax. Its attained location and scale are unique.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {p : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p ∈ Normal.domain) (hm : IsMaxOn (fun q : ℝ × ℝ ↦ likelihood x 0 q.1 q.2) Normal.domain p) : ∃! q, q ∈ Normal.domain ∧ IsMaxOn (fun q : ℝ × ℝ ↦ likelihood x 0 q.1 q.2) Normal.domain q

statement: For held positive width, the exact unattained height uses the unpenalized uniform in strict coverage and endpoint fractions at equality. At width zero constant data collapse through the normal family.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) : let D := Normal.domain let L := fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ likelihood x a p.1 p.2 (¬ ∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D p) ↔ (a = 0 ∧ ¬ BddAbove (L '' D)) ∨ (0 < a ∧ ∃ i j : Fin n, (∀ k, x i ≤ x k) ∧ (∀ k, x k ≤ x j) ∧ x j - x i ≤ 2*a ∧ let z := (Finset.univ.filter (fun k ↦ x k = x i)).card let o := (Finset.univ.filter (fun k ↦ x k = x j)).card let w := (z : ℝ) / ((z : ℝ) + o) let u := if x j - x i = 2*a then w^z * (1-w)^o / (2*a)^n else (1/(2*a))^n IsLUB (L '' D) u ∧ ∀ p ∈ D, L p < u)

statement: The attained held-centre normal scale is unique.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (m : ℝ) (h : ∃ s ∈ Ioi (0 : ℝ), IsMaxOn (likelihood x 0 m) (Ioi 0) s) : ∃! s, s ∈ Ioi (0 : ℝ) ∧ IsMaxOn (likelihood x 0 m) (Ioi 0) s

statement: Every level strictly above the compatible uniform height has its joint superlevel in a compact box, including at the normal seam. The radius lower bound applies to all eligible centres.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {S : Set ℝ} (hS : IsClosed S) {r J : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hradius : ∀ m ∈ S, ∃ i, r ≤ |x i - m|) (hJ : (1 / (2 * r)) ^ n < J) : ∃ K : Set (ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ)), IsCompact K ∧ K ⊆ Ici 0 ×ˢ (S ×ˢ Ioi 0) ∧ ∀ p ∈ Ici (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ (S ×ˢ Ioi 0), J ≤ likelihood x p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2 → p ∈ K

statement: Free centre and width compare the conditional stationary heights with the uniform covering the sample range. Constant data collapse on the included normal seam.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (i j : Fin n) (hi : ∀ k, x i ≤ x k) (hj : ∀ k, x k ≤ x j) : let r := (x j-x i)/2 let D := Ici (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ Normal.domain let L := fun p : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) ↦ likelihood x p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2 let B := (1 / (2 * r)) ^ n ((∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D p) ↔ 0 < r ∧ ∃ a ≥ 0, ∃ m s : ℝ, 0 < s ∧ ConditionalCandidate x univ a m s ∧ B ≤ likelihood x a m s) ∧ ((¬ ∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D p) ↔ (r = 0 ∧ ¬ BddAbove (L '' D)) ∨ (0 < r ∧ (∀ p ∈ D, L p < B) ∧ IsLUB (L '' D) B))

statement: At held centre, the covering radius is the largest absolute residual, including constant samples displaced from the held centre.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (m : ℝ) (i : Fin n) (hi : ∀ j, |x j - m| ≤ |x i - m|) : let r := |x i - m| let D := Ici (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ ({m} ×ˢ Ioi (0 : ℝ)) let L := fun p : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) ↦ likelihood x p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2 let B := (1 / (2 * r)) ^ n ((∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D p) ↔ 0 < r ∧ ∃ a ≥ 0, ∃ s > 0, ConditionalCandidate x {m} a m s ∧ B ≤ likelihood x a m s) ∧ ((¬ ∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D p) ↔ (r = 0 ∧ ¬ BddAbove (L '' D)) ∨ (0 < r ∧ (∀ p ∈ D, L p < B) ∧ IsLUB (L '' D) B))

statement: At positive held physical width, a midpoint in inverse scale and scaled location strictly increases the log likelihood above the mean of the two distinct endpoint fits.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) {S : Set ℝ} (hS : Convex ℝ S) {p q : ℝ × ℝ} (hp : p ∈ S ×ˢ Ioi (0 : ℝ)) (hq : q ∈ S ×ˢ Ioi (0 : ℝ)) (hne : p ≠ q) : ∃ z ∈ S ×ˢ Ioi (0 : ℝ), (log (likelihood x a p.1 p.2)+log (likelihood x a q.1 q.2))/2 < log (likelihood x a z.1 z.2)

statement: Every attained held-width fit is unique, including the width-zero normal member and every sample with endpoint ties.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (h : ∃ p ∈ Normal.domain, IsMaxOn (fun q : ℝ × ℝ ↦ likelihood x a q.1 q.2) Normal.domain p) : ∃! p, p ∈ Normal.domain ∧ IsMaxOn (fun q : ℝ × ℝ ↦ likelihood x a q.1 q.2) Normal.domain p

statement: Every attained scale fit at held width and centre is unique.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (m : ℝ) (h : ∃ s ∈ Ioi (0 : ℝ), IsMaxOn (likelihood x a m) (Ioi 0) s) : ∃! s, s ∈ Ioi (0 : ℝ) ∧ IsMaxOn (likelihood x a m) (Ioi 0) s

statement: On approaching zero scale, a bounded limiting location contributes the exponential prefactor. An observation strictly above or below that location contributes a CDF factor of one or zero, respectively. At contact the factor is the limiting CDF evaluated at the scaled location displacement.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {α : Type*} {f : Filter α} {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (r : ℝ) {m s : α → ℝ} {c w : ℝ} (hm : Tendsto m f (𝓝 c)) (hs : Tendsto s f (𝓝[>] 0)) (hw : Tendsto (fun t ↦ Φ ((c - m t) / s t)) f (𝓝 w)) : Tendsto (fun t ↦ ∏ j, density r (m t) (s t) (x j)) f (𝓝 (∏ j, r * exp (-r * (x j - c)) * (if c < x j then 1 else if x j < c then 0 else w)))

statement: At fixed positive rate all joint superlevels above the exponential face are confined to a compact location and positive-scale box.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) {i : Fin n} {r J : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hJ : (∏ j, r * exp (-r * (x j - x i))) < J) : ∃ K : Set (ℝ × ℝ), IsCompact K ∧ K ⊆ univ ×ˢ Ioi 0 ∧ ∀ p ∈ (univ : Set ℝ) ×ˢ Ioi (0 : ℝ), J ≤ (∏ j, density r p.1 p.2 (x j)) → p ∈ K

statement: At the sample minimum the joint contact penalty is one copy of the limiting Gaussian CDF value per observation tied there.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {α : Type*} {f : Filter α} {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) {i : Fin n} (hi : ∀ j, x i ≤ x j) (r : ℝ) {m s : α → ℝ} {w : ℝ} (hm : Tendsto m f (𝓝 (x i))) (hs : Tendsto s f (𝓝[>] 0)) (hw : Tendsto (fun t ↦ Φ ((x i - m t) / s t)) f (𝓝 w)) : Tendsto (fun t ↦ ∏ j, density r (m t) (s t) (x j)) f (𝓝 ((∏ j, r * exp (-r * (x j - x i))) * w^((Finset.univ.filter (fun j ↦ x j = x i)).card)))

statement: At fixed positive rate, the scale-zero face gives the only possible unattained supremum. The joined statement includes the full moving path and the joint contact penalty for sequences approaching the minimum.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) {i : Fin n} (hi : ∀ j, x i ≤ x j) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) : let D := univ ×ˢ Ioi (0 : ℝ) let L := fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ ∏ j, density r p.1 p.2 (x j) let B := ∏ j, r * exp (-r * (x j - x i)) Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ L (x i - t⁻¹, (t⁻¹)^2)) atTop (𝓝 B) ∧ (∀ (m s : ℕ → ℝ) (w : ℝ), Tendsto m atTop (𝓝 (x i)) → Tendsto s atTop (𝓝[>] 0) → Tendsto (fun t ↦ Φ ((x i - m t) / s t)) atTop (𝓝 w) → Tendsto (fun t ↦ L (m t,s t)) atTop (𝓝 (B*w^((Finset.univ.filter (fun j ↦ x j = x i)).card)))) ∧ ((¬ ∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D p) ↔ (∀ p ∈ D, L p < B) ∧ IsLUB (L '' D) B)

statement: The small-Gaussian-scale, large-rate corner has zero limiting likelihood whenever a residual at the held location is nonzero.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {α : Type*} {f : Filter α} {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (m : ℝ) {i : Fin n} (hi : x i ≠ m) {r s : α → ℝ} (hr : Tendsto r f atTop) (hs : Tendsto s f (𝓝[>] 0)) : Tendsto (fun t ↦ ∏ j, density (r t) m (s t) (x j)) f (𝓝 0)

statement: The fixed-location Gaussian face remains valid for jointly moving rate and scale when the Gaussian scale has a positive limit.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {α : Type*} {f : Filter α} {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (m : ℝ) {r s : α → ℝ} {s₀ : ℝ} (hs₀ : 0 < s₀) (hr : Tendsto r f atTop) (hs : Tendsto s f (𝓝 s₀)) : Tendsto (fun t ↦ ∏ j, density (r t) m (s t) (x j)) f (𝓝 (normalTrace x m s₀))

statement: The matched-location exponential trace is joint in Gaussian scale and rate. Observations at the held location retain half weight.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {α : Type*} {f : Filter α} {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (m : ℝ) {r s : α → ℝ} {r₀ : ℝ} (hr : Tendsto r f (𝓝 r₀)) (hs : Tendsto s f (𝓝[>] 0)) : Tendsto (fun t ↦ ∏ j, density (r t) m (s t) (x j)) f (𝓝 (exponentialTrace x r₀ m))

statement: With location held and a nonzero residual, every likelihood level above both optimized faces has a compact rate-scale superlevel.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (m : ℝ) {i : Fin n} (hi : x i ≠ m) {J : ℝ} (hJ : max (sSup (normalTrace x m '' Ioi 0)) (sSup ((fun r ↦ exponentialTrace x r m) '' Ioi 0)) < J) : ∃ K : Set (ℝ × ℝ), IsCompact K ∧ K ⊆ Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioi 0 ∧ ∀ p ∈ Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ Ioi (0 : ℝ), J ≤ (∏ j, density p.1 m p.2 (x j)) → p ∈ K

statement: At held location failure is exactly unbounded concentration when all residuals vanish, or strict loss to the larger of the two boundary heights.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin n → ℝ) (m : ℝ) : let D := Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ Ioi (0 : ℝ) let L := fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ ∏ j, density p.1 m p.2 (x j) let B := max (sSup (normalTrace x m '' Ioi 0)) (sSup ((fun r ↦ exponentialTrace x r m) '' Ioi 0)) (¬ ∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D p) ↔ ((∀ j, x j = m) ∧ Tendsto (fun s : ℝ ↦ L (s⁻¹,s)) (𝓝[>] 0) atTop) ∨ ((∃ j, x j ≠ m) ∧ (∀ p ∈ D, L p < B) ∧ IsLUB (L '' D) B)

statement: A compact set inside the feasible domain that contains the entire superlevel of one feasible witness suffices for global attainment.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {L : X → ℝ} {D K : Set X} (hK : IsCompact K) (hsub : K ⊆ D) (hL : ContinuousOn L D) {p : X} (hp : p ∈ D) (hcut : ∀ q ∈ D, L p ≤ L q → q ∈ K) : ∃ q ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D q

statement: Compact superlevels give eventual strict loss below the level on the cocompact filter of the feasible subtype.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] {L : X → ℝ} {D K : Set X} {J : ℝ} (hK : IsCompact K) (hsub : K ⊆ D) (hcut : ∀ q ∈ D, J ≤ L q → q ∈ K) : ∀ᶠ q : D in cocompact D, L q < J

statement: At a joint maximum the optimized profile is stationary if the fixed-nuisance slice is stationary. The slice and the maximum height sandwich the profile difference, even when the profile is defined by a supremum and the nuisance argmax is set-valued.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {X : Type*} {D : Set X} {U : Set ℝ} {f : ℝ → X → ℝ} {c : ℝ} {p : X} (hp : p ∈ D) (hc : U ∈ 𝓝 c) (hmax : ∀ t ∈ U, ∀ q ∈ D, f t q ≤ f c p) (hd : HasDerivAt (fun t ↦ f t p) 0 c) : HasDerivAt (fun t ↦ sSup (f t '' D)) 0 c
